elements.text: Fit the handlebar so the display faces the rider. Tighten the stem bolts to 6 Nm, alternating between them.
Fit both mudguards before the first ride. Use the four bolts supplied and check that neither mudguard touches the tyre when the wheels turn.
Fit the front rack to the fork eyelets and the rear rack to the frame eyelets. Tighten all rack bolts to 5 Nm. The rear rack carries up to 25 kg.
Route both brake hoses through the frame guides. Do not kink the hoses; a kinked hose must be replaced.
The left pedal has a reverse thread. Turn it counterclockwise to tighten.
